# NVS is 0x20000 (128 KB = 32 pages) -> (32 - 1) x 126 = 3906 usable entries

# anything placed below the app would push the app off 0x10000. A gap is legal (the ESP-IDF
# tool only rejects overlaps) and 28 KB is a cheap price for a bootable board.
